Most CARASIL missense proteins tested did not inhibit wild-type HTRA1.

nodes.description: HTRA1 controls TGF-beta bioavailability, but the direction of the change in disease is contested. CARASIL mutant proteins fail to repress TGF-beta family signalling and TGF-beta1 accumulates in the tunica media of patient arteries; HTRA1 cleaves proTGF-beta1 in the endoplasmic reticulum; and HTRA1-null smooth muscle cells and a transgenic CARASIL mouse show increased SMAD2/3 signalling. Against this, HTRA1 also processes LTBP-1, and its loss attenuates TGF-beta signalling in fibroblasts, while carrier fibroblasts show no change in phospho-SMAD2/3. The node is therefore annotated as dysregulated rather than increased.
